xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2859 - release Phase 1 file-and-merge blocker (AGENTS.md bulk rejected)

plan.title: release: on task check failure, file-and-merge the blocker — do not lead with inline hotfix (AGENTS.md bulk rejected)

narratives.Description: When release Phase 1 task check fails on a fixable defect, agents must file a GitHub issue and drive it through merge before resuming the cut. Leading with an inline hotfix or untracked --skip-ci is the wrong default; AGENTS.md bulk for this reminder is explicitly rejected.
narratives.Overview: Harden deft-directive-release Phase 1 so task-check failures on fixable defects route through issue -> PR -> merge before the cut resumes. Explicitly reject AGENTS.md bulk for this process reminder.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a release, I want the release skill to require filing and merging a fixable task-check blocker before resume, so that agents do not lead with inline hotfix theater or untracked skip-ci.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json (deft-directive-release Phase 1) to require file-and-merge on fixable task check / ci:local failures, note AGENTS.md bulk rejection, and retain --allow-skip-ci=#N. Run task packs:render so content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md updates. Optionally add a short entry in content/packs/lessons/lessons-pack-0.1.json and a pointer in docs/RELEASING.md. Verify with rg for #2859 / file-and-merge / AGENTS.md rejected in the rendered skill; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2859; no AGENTS.md or agents-entry edits.

items.title: Given Phase 1 task check fails on a fixable defect, when the release skill is followed, then the agent files an issue and processes through merge before resume.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fixable task check failure, when Phase 1 runs, then the skill requires file-and-merge and forbids leading with inline-only hotfix or untracked skip-ci.

items.title: Given the skill text, when operators read the AGENTS.md note, then bulk expansion is marked considered and rejected.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the updated skill/lesson text, when it mentions AGENTS.md, then it states expansion was considered and rejected per #2859.

items.title: Given the change lands, when CHANGELOG or lesson is updated, then #2859 is cited.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the PR, when Unreleased or the lesson entry is present, then it cites #2859.

items.title: Given the fix, when AGENTS.md and agents-entry are checked, then they are unchanged for this rule.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the PR diff, when AGENTS.md / content/templates/agents-entry.md are inspected for this reminder, then no new always-pin bulk was added.
